# rapttor/yii2-legal

> Yii2 package for multilingual legal pages, consents and privacy requests, from one company config, in 22 languages with a language switcher: terms, privacy, cookies, imprint, refunds, DPA, game rules, app terms, licence. Also one-checkbox-per-item consents with proof, cookie consent, email stop and block, a privacy request form, and country restrictions per app activity. Texts come from rapttor/legal, bundled by Composer, no runtime network access.

Integrating or changing this package: read AGENTS.md first. It lists what to ask the owner, what never to invent, and the promises the legal texts make that the app must keep. In an app that uses it, run `php yii legal/agents --llms` to write the checklist, the activity tags and the country lists into the app's own AGENTS.md and llms.txt.

## Read first
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): integration steps, rules, promises checklist, how to change the package
- [README.md](README.md): install, configuration, languages, consents, requests, console commands, safety
- Upstream texts and rules: https://github.com/rapttor/rapttor.legal (AGENTS.md, SPEC.md, i18n/BRIEF-sh.md)

## What it provides
- Pages and languages: [src/Legal.php](src/Legal.php) (the component: documents(), html(), url(), offered(), appName(), visitorLanguage()), [src/controllers/LegalController.php](src/controllers/LegalController.php) (pages, hreflang, request form, consent screens), [src/widgets/LanguageSwitcher.php](src/widgets/LanguageSwitcher.php) (one-row language strip, flags, `sameRoute` for forms), [src/widgets/LegalLinks.php](src/widgets/LegalLinks.php). Languages: English, Balkan `sh` (aliases sr, hr, bs, cnr, sr-Cyrl), de, fr, es, es-MX, pt-BR, it, pl, nl, tr, sv, ro, id, vi, uk, ru, ar, hi, ja, ko, zh-Hans (drafts until reviewed); the Balkan wording rules are in rapttor/legal `i18n/BRIEF-sh.md`.
- Consents: [src/Consents.php](src/Consents.php), [src/widgets/ConsentChecklist.php](src/widgets/ConsentChecklist.php), [src/filters/ConsentGate.php](src/filters/ConsentGate.php), [src/stores/](src/stores/). On by default for every app: the documents, age and legal-age confirmation, upload responsibility. Opt-in: gambling, marketing, third-party resources, custom `consents`, and the regions checkbox from `policy.activities`. Every item is its own unticked checkbox with a short title and a small-print hint. The record per account (version, time, language, hashed IP and browser, wording and document hashes, history) is kept through https://github.com/rapttor/yii2-metadata (`key=legal`, `remote_table=profile`): export with `metadata->export()`, delete with `deleteAll()` on account deletion.
- New-account sign-in: `ConsentChecklist::widget()` in the sign-in form, `consents()->missingRequired()` before creating the account, `consents()->record($user->id, $answers, 'signup')` after; the title is `appName()`, an intro only if `signupIntro` is set. Your own superadmins skip the gate with `exceptCan`; tenant admins consent like everybody else.
- Activity tags: set `policy.activities` (gambling, alcohol, tobacco, cannabis, adult, dating, lgbtq, crypto, vpn, weapons, pharmacy, sanctions; add `sanctions` to every app). The countries that prohibit them become one required checkbox in the visitor's language (data in rapttor/legal `restrictions/`, with source and confidence; counsel confirms). `php yii legal/restrictions [tag]` lists them. Never claim geo-blocking.
- Your own legal pages (attribution, special policies, credits): `Legal::$extraPages` (title and url per language, relative paths or route arrays); they join the legal index, `LegalLinks` and the list under each document; `Yii::$app->legal->links($lang)` returns the full list. Do not build a second list of legal pages.
- Privacy and legal requests: [src/Requests.php](src/Requests.php), route `/legal/request`; attach a handler to `Legal::EVENT_REQUEST` to alert your admins and show `requests()->open()` in your backoffice. Never promise a reply time on any page or form unless a law requires one.
- Other: [src/External.php](src/External.php) (third-party resources), [src/Email.php](src/Email.php) and [src/blocklist/](src/blocklist/) (stop optional mail, block all, Postar), [src/Withdrawal.php](src/Withdrawal.php) (EU withdrawal), [src/Acceptance.php](src/Acceptance.php) (append-only acceptance log).

## Tests
- [tests/](tests/): behaviour covered (sanitising, languages, routes, consents and evidence, requests, regions, email, withdrawal); run `composer install && vendor/bin/phpunit`
